approaches_tried.approach: Extend _OVERLAY_BASES to include '|' and rely on plain NFC composition
approaches_tried.reason: U+2224 DOES NOT DIVIDE canonically decomposes to U+2223 (MATH divides symbol) + U+0338, not ASCII U+007C + U+0338, so NFC silently failed to compose '|' + mark; added a small _CANONICAL_BASE_OVERRIDE map for this case
